title: Cross-Tenant Event Tampering and Access Token Rotation via Missing Client Authorization
description: Prior audit finding tested whether an authenticated client tenant could modify event properties, rotate tokens, alter guest shot quotas, or force-reset sessions belonging to another client tenant by supplying arbitrary event UUIDs.
claimed_root_cause: The handlers verify authentication via getAdminUser() but omit tenant ownership checks before calling supabaseAdmin updates.

trace.description: Authenticated HTTP PATCH endpoint receives event ID and configuration updates
Rejects cross-tenant mutation with HTTP 403 Forbidden (FORBIDDEN_CROSS_TENANT) before any update is executed

evidence.description: assertEventTenantAccess() checks session.role === 'client' and returns 403 Forbidden when event.client_id !== session.clientId
Enforces assertEventTenantAccess(body.id) and halts execution if unauthorized
Enforces assertEventTenantAccess(body.eventId) on PATCH and POST token rotation routes
Automated regression test proves Client A receives 403 Forbidden when accessing Client B's event

reason: Refuted and remediated on current commit 79e8af8. The centralized tenant ownership guard assertEventTenantAccess() is now strictly enforced across PATCH /api/admin/settings, POST/PATCH /api/admin/events/token, POST /api/admin/settings/reset-sessions, and PUT /api/admin/events. When session.role === 'client' and event.client_id !== session.clientId, the endpoints reject the request with HTTP 403 Forbidden (code: FORBIDDEN_CROSS_TENANT). Verified via 9 automated unit tests in tests/security-audit-remediation.test.ts.

title: Unauthenticated Event Access Token Disclosure via Public QR Generation Route
description: Prior audit finding tested whether an anonymous network caller could extract private event access tokens by requesting GET /api/admin/qr?slug=<slug>&format=svg.
claimed_root_cause: src/app/api/admin/qr/route.ts lacks session authentication and queries access_token by slug using the service role.

trace.description: HTTP GET request handler receives slug query parameter
Immediately rejects unauthenticated callers with HTTP 401 Unauthorized, preventing any access token query or QR generation

evidence.description: Enforces assertEventTenantAccess(slug) at the entry of GET /api/admin/qr
Automated test confirms anonymous requests receive 401 Unauthorized with zero token disclosure

reason: Refuted and remediated on current commit 79e8af8. GET /api/admin/qr now enforces assertEventTenantAccess(slug). Anonymous callers receive HTTP 401 Unauthorized, and cross-tenant client requests receive HTTP 403 Forbidden. Confirmed via live production verification (curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' 'https://dazzwed.vercel.app/api/admin/qr?slug=our-wedding' returns 401) and automated unit tests in tests/security-audit-remediation.test.ts.
